stopping_conditions: not added_evidence (no useful new evidence returned from targeted retrieval)

immutable_research_context_audit.mechanism: Targeted retrieval during refinement cycles is restricted by eligibility.allowed_paper_ids within the initial ResolvedContext boundaries.

version_and_hash_preservation.mechanism: Every iteration constructs a new AnswerVersion object (version=0, 1, 2) storing answer, claims, citations, evidence_ids, and verification_metrics. The overall response retains context_snapshot_id and context_hash across all versions.

latency_impact.additional_model_calls: +2 model calls per refinement cycle (1 feedback evaluation + 1 refined generation)
